1.web: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, Yahweh appeared to Abram, and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me, and be blameless.
1.asv: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, Jehovah appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am God Almighty; walk before me, and be thou perfect.

2.web: I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.”
2.asv: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.

3.web: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,
3.asv: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,

4.web: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.
4.asv: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be the father of a multitude of nations.

5.web: Neither will your name any more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.
5.asv: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for the father of a multitude of nations have I made thee.

6.web: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.
6.asv: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.

7.web: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your seed after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your seed after you.
7.asv: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee and to thy seed after thee.

8.web: I will give to you, and to your seed after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”
8.asv: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land of thy sojournings, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.

9.web: God said to Abraham, “As for you, you will keep my covenant, you and your seed after you throughout their generations.
9.asv: And God said unto Abraham, And as for thee, thou shalt keep my covenant, thou, and thy seed after thee throughout their generations.

10.web: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your seed after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.
10.asv: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee: every male among you shall be circumcised.

11.web: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.
11.asv: And ye shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of a covenant betwixt me and you.

12.web: He who is eight days old will be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he who is born in the house, or bought with money from any foreigner who is not of your seed.
12.asv: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any foreigner that is not of thy seed.

13.web: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant will be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
13.asv: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

14.web: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”
14.asv: And the uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.

15.web: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name will be Sarah.
15.asv: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.

16.web: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”
16.asv: And I will bless her, and moreover I will give thee a son of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of peoples shall be of her.

17.web: Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”
17.asv: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is a hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?

18.web: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”
18.asv: And Abraham said unto God, Oh that Ishmael might live before thee!

19.web: God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his seed after him.
19.asv: And God said, Nay, but Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his seed after him.

20.web: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.
20.asv: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.

21.web: But my covenant I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”
21.asv: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.

22.web: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.
22.asv: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.

23.web: Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money; every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day, as God had said to him.
23.asv: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.

24.web: Abraham was ninety-nine years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
24.asv: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

25.web: Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
25.asv: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

26.web: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.
26.asv: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.

27.web: All the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money of a foreigner, were circumcised with him.
27.asv: And all the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money of a foreigner, were circumcised with him.
